newsitem.title: USA: FCOJ weekly movement up to 4.717 million gallons.
newsitem.headline: FCOJ weekly movement up to 4.717 million gallons.

text.p: The Florida Citrus Processors Association said frozen concentrated orange juice movement into trade channels for the week ended September 14 was 4,716,630 gallons compared with 4,053,569 gallons last week.
Imports were zero gallons compared with 118,696 gallons the previous week, and domestic receipts totaled 74,221 gallons versus 20,931 gallons a week ago.
Retail movement was 1,067,300 gallons compared with 1,093,337 gallons last year, while bulk movement was 3,052,990 gallons versus 4,228,292 gallons last year.
Current season cumulative movement was 216,292,401 versus 214,619,235 a year ago.
Inventory was 81,163,231 versus 90,619,292 gallons last year.
The final total pack for the season is 202,353,371 gallons compared with 216,502,392 gallons a year ago.
